timing_placement_carrier.description: coordinate timing method; explicit direct_loss or pin2pin selects mutually exclusive GP controls; gradient_net_weight retains gradient projection

timing_topology_refresh_interval.description: GP steps between full timing topology refreshes

timing_topology_enable_overflow_threshol.description: density overflow below which timing topology updates activate

placement_sizing_mode.description: placement optimization lane, place_only | size_only | joint

discrete_gradient_topk_shared_budget_per.description: percentage of sizeable cells sharing one size/VT action budget

buffering_segment_strategy.description: segment count optimization strategy, continuous | discrete_net_gradient

buffering_segment_count_z_init.description: initial relaxed repeater count on each segment

buffering_fixed_bsu_index.description: optional fixed buffer index resolved from the legal buffer table

buffering_max_repeaters_per_segment.description: maximum accepted repeaters on one segment

buffering_route_b_selection_fraction.description: fraction of segment candidates selected in one discrete buffering batch

buffering_segment_live_geometry.description: update buffered segment timing from current placement geometry

buffering_segment_integer_projection_int.description: GP steps between integer buffer projection calls; 0 disables periodic projection

buffering_segment_integer_projection_sta.description: first GP step eligible for periodic buffer projection

buffering_segment_integer_projection_pro.description: project buffer master indices together with integer repeater counts

buffering_discrete_count_proximal_lambda.description: proximal penalty coefficient for discrete repeater count changes

joint_segment_virtual_density_enabled.description: include persistent virtual buffer footprints in placement density

buffering_segment_projection_min_z_to_in.description: minimum relaxed repeater count eligible for physical insertion

buffering_segment_count_tns_gradient.description: enable TNS gradients with respect to segment repeater counts

timing_obj_profile_interval.description: steps between timing objective performance summaries

l_shape_grad_target_ratio_max.description: maximum adaptive routability gradient target ratio

buffering_continuous_steps.description: number of steps in the standalone buffering optimizer

buffering_fixed_buffer_master.description: physical buffer master used for Segment buffering

discrete_gradient_topk_up_percent.description: cell percentage eligible for discrete upsizing

discrete_gradient_topk_vt_percent.description: cell percentage eligible for discrete VT changes

early_stop_restore_best.description: restore the best continuous sizing state at the end of optimization

flow_kind.description: optimization profile executed inside the placement step

joint_quality_profile.description: optional canonical profile for joint optimization

place_io_engine.description: physical database backend used by DREAMPlace

placement_initial_learning_rate_max.description: optional cap for the estimated initial placement learning rate

rc_tcl.description: OpenROAD RC setup Tcl, resolved relative to the PDK root when relative

timing_surrogate_mode.description: cell timing evaluation mode, auto | mixed | lut_only | surrogate_only

diff_timing_driven_placement.description: enable differentiable timing in the placement flow

openroad_vt_suffixes.description: OpenROAD VT suffixes used to classify equivalent Liberty cells

verilog_input.description: input VERILOG file, provide circuit netlist information if it is not included in DEF file

num_bins_x.description: number of bins in horizontal direction

num_bins_y.description: number of bins in vertical direction

global_place_stages.description: global placement configurations of each stage, a dictionary of {"num_bins_x", "num_bins_y", "iteration", "learning_rate", "learning_rate_decay", "wirelength", "optimizer", "Llambda_density_weight_iteration", "Lsub_iteration"}

timing_grad_balance_target_ratio.description: initial target ratio rho between weighted timing-gradient and wirelength-gradient L1 norms; 0 disables automatic timing-gradient balancing

real_size_learning_rate.description: Adam learning rate in continuous Liberty/LUT size-coordinate units

real_size_warmup_steps.description: number of real-size Adam steps before a warmup-to-discrete transition

real_size_transition_backend.description: real-size transition backend, reference | vectorized | native

real_size_transition_artifact_policy.description: transition projection artifact policy, summary_only | full

real_size_transition_profile.description: write a compact real-size transition profile

net_weighting_npaths.description: legacy net-selection percentage alias; 3.0 matches Efficient-TDP's 3 percent of nets, 0 keeps all violating max-timing states

use_bb.description: whether to use Barzilai-Borwein step-size updates in Nesterov optimization

net_weighting_nendpoints.description: maximum violating endpoint-transition states selected per pin2pin update; 0 keeps all violating states

scale_factor.description: scale factor to avoid numerical overflow; 0.0 means not set

ignore_net_weight.description: ignore net weight larger than some value for weight_hpwl reporting

shift_factor.description: shift factor to avoid numerical issues when the lower-left origin of rows is not (0, 0);

ignore_net_degree.description: ignore net degree larger than some value

gp_noise_ratio.description: noise to initial positions for global placement

auto_adjust_bins.description: automatically derive num_bins_x and num_bins_y from the number of physical nodes

stop_overflow.description: stopping criteria, consider stop when the overflow reaches to a ratio

detailed_place_engine.description: external detailed placement engine to be called after placement

detailed_place_command.description: commands for external detailed placement engine

RePlAce_ref_hpwl.description: reference HPWL used in RePlAce for updating density weight

RePlAce_LOWER_PCOF.description: lower bound ratio used in RePlAce for updating density weight

RePlAce_UPPER_PCOF.description: upper bound ratio used in RePlAce for updating density weight

gamma.description: base coefficient for log-sum-exp and weighted-average wirelength, a relative value to bin size

RePlAce_skip_energy_flag.description: whether skip density energy computation for fast mode, may not work with some solvers

random_center_init_flag.description: whether perform random initialization for global placement

init_loc_perc_x.description: initial horizontal location of cells for global placement (% of layout width)

init_loc_perc_y.description: initial vertical location of cells for global placement (% of layout height)

sort_nets_by_degree.description: whether sort nets by degree or not

dump_global_place_solution_flag.description: whether dump intermediate global placement solution as a compressed pickle object

dump_legalize_solution_flag.description: whether dump intermediate legalization solution as a compressed pickle object

macro_only.description: commit only frozen unplaced hard macro coordinates

node_area_adjust_overflow.description: the overflow where to adjust node area

inflation_min_interval.description: minimum completed GP steps between applied inflation rounds; 0 disables the interval guard

timing_opt_enabled.description: run the electrical timing-optimization windows during placement

timing_opt_buffering_enabled.description: enable segment buffering in electrical timing-optimization windows

timing_opt_max_windows.description: maximum timing-optimization windows in one placement run, up to five

timing_opt_overflow_milestones.description: descending one-shot overflow thresholds for timing-optimization windows; empty uses inflation-triggered windows

timing_opt_sizing_rounds.description: maximum discrete size/VT rounds in each timing-optimization window, up to ten

two_stage_density_scaler.description: scale density weight after the macro placement stage

max_num_area_adjust.description: maximum times to adjust node area

adjust_nctugr_area_flag.description: legacy compatibility key; when enabled use the ECC/iRT EGR congestion map for area adjustment (NCTUgr is not invoked)

adjust_rudy_area_flag.description: whether use RUDY/RISA map to guide area adjustment

adjust_pin_area_flag.description: whether use pin utilization map to guide area adjustment

unit_horizontal_capacity.description: number of horizontal routing tracks per unit distance

unit_vertical_capacity.description: number of vertical routing tracks per unit distance

unit_pin_capacity.description: number of pins per unit area

route_opt_adjust_exponent.description: exponent to adjust the routing utilization map

deterministic_flag.description: whether require run-to-run determinism, may have efficiency overhead

timing_opt_flag.description: legacy timing-driven global placement flag; enabling it raises an error because OpenTimer integration has been removed

net_weighting_scheme.description: net-weighting scheme for timing-aware optimization, e.g. adam | lilith

momentum_decay_factor.description: momentum decay factor used in timing-aware net-weight updates

enable_net_weighting.description: enable timing-aware net weighting during global placement

max_net_weight.description: maximum net weight for timing optimization; negative values or "inf" mean no limit

pin2pin_net_weighting.description: enable pin-to-pin net weighting for timing optimization

pin2pin_weight.description: base multiplier for pin-to-pin net weights

start_iter.description: iteration to start pin-to-pin timing weighting

min_stop_iter.description: minimum iteration before convergence checking in timing-aware mode

pin2pin_accumulate_weight.description: increment added when accumulating an extra critical path

get_congestion_map.description: compute congestion map after placement complete

egr_padding_flag.description: run internal iRT EGR local padding before legalization

macro_overlap_weight.description: initial weight of macro overlap cost

macro_overlap_mult_weight.description: weight multiplier for MFP macro overlap

cell_padding_x.description: horizontal padding around macros for MFP macro overlap

bndry_padding_x.description: horizontal padding around the edges of the floorplan

bndry_padding_y.description: vertical padding around the edges of the floorplan

pin_density.description: target pin density for cells inflation

route_info_input.description: route information file (w. total H/V routing length & macro routing length contribution)

evaluate_pl.description: evaluate .pl file without running anything (e.g., to get baseline PPA)

risa_weights.description: whether use weighted smooth HPWL with RISA net weights

macro_pin_halo_x.description: horizontal halo applied to macro pins for pin-aware macro shaping

macro_pin_halo_y.description: vertical halo applied to macro pins for pin-aware macro shaping

with_sta.description: enable integrated STA initialization and differentiable timing updates during placement

export_pin_violation_csv.description: export detailed per-pin slew/cap violation CSV files; disabled by default because it is expensive on large designs

differentiable_timing_obj.description: compatibility flag for differentiable timing objective configuration

joint_buffer_commit_period.description: optimizer step interval between joint physical commit requests

joint_buffer_outer_iterations.description: maximum joint optimizer windows separated by native refresh

base_design_name.description: base design name used when naming dumped solutions and reports

precond_pin_count_flag.description: add original DreamPlace per-node raw pin count to the shared gradient preconditioner before clamping; 0 keeps density-area-only preconditioning, 1 enables pin count (not net-weighted PWS)

enhanced_auto_adjust_bins.description: enable enhanced automatic placement bin adjustment; when enabled, it overrides auto_adjust_bins, keeps the configured bin preset unless num_bins_y exceeds the placement row count, and then caps num_bins_y to the largest power of two not exceeding the row count while preserving the configured num_bins_x/num_bins_y ratio

iopin_density_weight.description: extra I/O pin density weight added to the electric initial density map; 0 disables the extra I/O pin density increment, 3 matches Xplace's extra 3*Diopin term

ieda_m2_pg_rail_blockage_flag.description: whether convert iEDA VDD/VSS special-net shapes on the second routing layer into synthetic placement blockages

m2_pg_rail_density_weight.description: M2 PG rail soft density weight added to the electric initial density map when ieda_m2_pg_rail_blockage_flag is disabled; 0 disables the soft density path, 1 matches the old hard-node rail density contribution

m2_pg_rail_legalization_blockage_flag.description: whether run the M2 rail-aware legalization mode selected by m2_pg_rail_legalization_mode

m2_pg_rail_legalization_mode.description: M2 rail-aware legalization algorithm: soft runs ordinary legalization followed by soft rail-overlap reduction; hybrid_hard uses all rails as temporary hard obstacles while reserving unavoidable single-row wide cells; subset_hard uses only the inclusive left-to-right rail-index range selected by m2_pg_rail_legalization_hard_rail_start and m2_pg_rail_legalization_hard_rail_end

m2_pg_rail_legalization_hard_rail_start.description: 1-based left-to-right first M2 rail used as a temporary hard obstacle in subset_hard legalization; ignored by other modes

m2_pg_rail_legalization_hard_rail_end.description: 1-based left-to-right last M2 rail used as a temporary hard obstacle in subset_hard legalization, inclusive; ignored by other modes

m2_pg_rail_legalization_displacement_wei.description: displacement-area penalty relative to M2 rail overlap-area improvement in soft M2 legalization; 0 prioritizes rail overlap only

m2_pa_refine_flag.description: whether run Xplace-style row-based PA-Refine after legalization and optional detailed placement to move single-row cells away from vertical M2 PG rails

m2_pa_refine_max_neighbors.description: maximum local row-neighbor search depth for M2 PA-Refine

m2_pa_refine_max_displacement_sites.description: maximum summed displacement in site widths for one M2 PA-Refine move candidate

inflation_area_budget_ratio.description: maximum fraction of the total whitespace area that routability inflation may add to movable nodes in one area-adjust round

legalize_before_each_inflation_flag.description: whether each ordinary inflation round waits for stop_overflow, legalizes physical cell geometry, runs congestion estimation, and then reapplies cumulative inflation before area adjustment

enhanced_inflation_flag.description: whether enable the enhanced outer-loop inflation controller skeleton

enhanced_inflation_min_area_inc.description: minimum relative area increment ratio to keep an enhanced inflation round

enhanced_inflation_replay_best_round_fla.description: whether replay the best recorded enhanced inflation round after rolling back inflated geometry

enhanced_inflation_select_metric.description: metric name used to select the best enhanced inflation round

gpugr_first_inflation_exit.description: run the external gpugr operator before the first routability area-adjust round, then exit immediately

gpugr_first_inflation_rrr_iters.description: rrrIters passed to gpugr when gpugr_first_inflation_exit is enabled

timing_rc_mode.description: timing parasitics, placement | gr; gr requires native ECC CPU sizing or STA

cell_model_schema.description: cell timing model schema; null uses the existing flow default

gpugr_backend.description: GGR backend selection: auto chooses cuda when available and cpu_pr_mt otherwise; cuda requires a CUDA-capable gpugr build; cpu_pr is explicit serial diagnostic pattern routing; cpu_pr_mt is deterministic parallel CPU pattern routing; cpu_pr_maze is opt-in CPU pattern plus maze RRR; CPU pattern backends use num_threads as their requested worker count

gr_sizing_rrr_iters.description: bounded CPU maze RRR iterations for standalone GR sizing; positive values require gpugr_backend=cpu_pr_maze and default is zero

gpugr_bottom_routing_layer.description: inclusive bottom routing-layer name passed to GPUGR; empty uses the first LEF routing layer

gpugr_top_routing_layer.description: inclusive top routing-layer name passed to GPUGR; empty uses the last LEF routing layer

adjust_gpugr_area_flag.description: whether use Xplace gpugr overflow map to guide area adjustment

gpugr_area_adjust_rrr_iters.description: rrrIters passed to gpugr when adjust_gpugr_area_flag is enabled

gpugr_area_adjust_skip_m1_route.description: whether skip M1 when converting gpugr demand/capacity into overflow maps for area adjustment

gpugr_area_adjust_keep_temp_def.description: whether keep temporary DEF files produced by the gpugr area-adjust operator

gpugr_area_adjust_save_artifacts.description: whether save npz/json/png artifacts for each gpugr area-adjust call

gpugr_area_adjust_verbose_parser_log.description: whether print verbose Xplace parser logs during gpugr area adjustment

gpugr_area_adjust_cpp_log_level.description: Xplace C++ parser log level for gpugr area adjustment

l_direction_use_gpugr.description: whether use Xplace gpugr route entries instead of iRT EGR guide to resolve L directions

l_shape_use_ggr_topology.description: whether use GGR-exported L-shape topology pack instead of diff-side FLUTE refresh for L-shape routability

l_shape_plot_flag.description: whether plot L-shape steiner/guide figures during L-shape routability iterations

l_shape_capacity_al_enable.description: whether use per-routing-bin AL multiplier memory as the hard-GGR L-shape capacity-pressure source

l_shape_gradient_mode.description: routing gradient mode: translation preserves fixed-size field guidance; full differentiates the fixed-epoch electric energy through positions and segment dimensions (hard L, electric only)

l_shape_fast_mode.description: whether L-shape electric potential skips scalar potential-energy computation while preserving current-iteration electric-field gradients; invalid energy telemetry is reported with l_shape_energy_valid=0

l_shape_boundary_source_enable.description: whether add a fixed boundary-ring capacity-occupancy source to L-shape electric potential

l_shape_boundary_source_width_bins.description: number of L-shape bins in the boundary-ring fixed source

l_shape_boundary_source_strength.description: fraction of min(local capacity, capacity p95) occupied by the L-shape boundary-ring source

gpugr_l_direction_rrr_iters.description: rrrIters passed to gpugr when l_direction_use_gpugr is enabled

gpugr_l_direction_save_artifacts.description: whether save gpugr artifacts when l_direction_use_gpugr is enabled

gpugr_parser_cache_enable.description: whether keep the Xplace gpugr parser DB alive and update movable coordinates by instance name between diff refreshes

gpugr_area_adjust_congestion_mode.description: congestion signal used by GPUGR area inflation: union, direction-sensitive max_hv, or direction-sensitive max_hv_effective using routed wire plus via demand over nominal capacity minus fixed and movable obstacle usage

gpugr_final_eval_flag.description: whether run a final gpugr evaluation after placement finishes, similar to Xplace final_route_eval

gpugr_final_eval_rrr_iters.description: rrrIters passed to gpugr final evaluation

gpugr_final_eval_skip_m1_route.description: whether skip M1 when converting gpugr demand/capacity into final evaluation metrics

gpugr_final_eval_save_artifacts.description: whether save npz/json/png artifacts for gpugr final evaluation

gpugr_final_eval_keep_temp_def.description: whether keep temporary DEF files produced by gpugr final evaluation

gpugr_final_eval_verbose_parser_log.description: whether print verbose Xplace parser logs during gpugr final evaluation

gpugr_final_eval_cpp_log_level.description: Xplace C++ parser log level for gpugr final evaluation

gpugr_final_eval_route_xsize.description: optional route_xSize override for gpugr final evaluation; use 0 to follow the Xplace grid rule

gpugr_final_eval_route_ysize.description: optional route_ySize override for gpugr final evaluation; use 0 to follow the Xplace grid rule

post_legalization_adaptive_padding_flag.description: whether run gpugr after legalization and apply congestion-ranked per-cell x padding through an incremental legalization pass

post_legalization_padding_rounds.description: number of cumulative GGR padding and legalization rounds (1 retains the existing single-pass mode)

post_legalization_padding_overflow_bin_r.description: fraction of positive-overflow GGR bins considered in iterative legalization-only padding

post_legalization_padding_hot_cell_ratio.description: fraction of eligible movable cells considered for post-legalization adaptive padding

post_legalization_padding_row_free_ratio.description: fraction of each row segment's free sites available to adaptive padding

post_legalization_padding_max_sites.description: maximum adaptive x padding in sites on each side of a selected cell

post_legalization_padding_smooth_kernel.description: positive odd pooling kernel used to smooth the gpugr directional overflow map before cell scoring

post_legalization_padding_max_retries.description: maximum number of padded legalization retries; each retry drops the lower-scored half of padded cells

post_legalization_padding_rrr_iters.description: rrrIters passed to the post-legalization gpugr call used for adaptive padding

post_legalization_padding_skip_m1_route.description: whether skip M1 when building post-legalization adaptive-padding overflow maps

post_legalization_padding_save_artifacts.description: whether save gpugr maps, metrics, and PNGs for the post-legalization adaptive-padding call

l_shape_grad_target_ratio.description: target ratio between weighted preconditioned L-shape gradient norm and preconditioned base wirelength+density gradient norm

l_shape_overflow_threshold.description: placement overflow threshold below which disabled L-shape diff/routability force is allowed to start or re-enable

l_shape_update_interval.description: number of global-placement iterations between L-shape topology and direction refreshes

l_shape_filler_reverse_force.description: strength of filler reverse force: push fillers TOWARD congested areas using the L-shape Poisson field, so fillers occupy congested bins and density gradient locks real cells away; 0 disables

l_shape_filler_pseudo_wire_ratio.description: ratio of fillers to pull toward the most congested point using pseudo wire force; 0.05 means 5% of fillers are selected randomly and attracted to the max congestion bin

l_shape_keep_during_inflation.description: keep L-shape routability enabled during inflation (normally disabled); enables filler pseudo wire force to work with inflation

l_shape_weight_momentum.description: EMA momentum used by the adaptive per-iteration L-shape weight controller

l_shape_weight_min.description: minimum allowed l_shape_routability_weight after adaptive update

l_shape_weight_max.description: maximum allowed l_shape_routability_weight after adaptive update

l_shape_log_verbose.description: verbosity for non-timing L-shape/Soft-L diagnostic logs: 0 keeps production logs quiet, 1 adds one-line refresh summaries, 2 enables detailed per-iteration and per-refresh diagnostics

l_shape_mask_debug.description: force periodic L-shape gradient mask diagnostics regardless of l_shape_log_verbose; disabled by default

l_shape_mask_debug_interval.description: iteration interval for L-shape gradient mask diagnostics when l_shape_mask_debug is enabled or l_shape_log_verbose >= 2

l_shape_profile_flag.description: enable scoped timing logs for diff/soft-L routability profiling; inserts CUDA synchronizations around timed regions

l_shape_collect_edge_geometry_stats.description: collect diagnostic Steiner/GGR edge geometry statistics during topology rebuild/load; disabled by default to avoid production refresh overhead

l_shape_edge_net_ids_cache_flag.description: whether cache per-edge net ids used by soft-L same-net topology scoring; disable for profiling or QoR isolation

l_shape_debug_hash_flag.description: enable debug tensor hashes for soft-L routability divergence localization

l_shape_debug_hash_start_iter.description: first global placement iteration to emit soft-L debug tensor hashes; negative means no lower bound

l_shape_debug_hash_end_iter.description: last global placement iteration to emit soft-L debug tensor hashes; negative means no upper bound

l_shape_debug_hash_sample.description: number of tensor elements sampled for debug hashes; 0 hashes full tensors

soft_l_adaptive_tau.description: whether adapt soft-L temperature from the current batch median absolute H/V cost gap

soft_l_adaptive_scale.description: scale factor multiplied onto the median absolute H/V cost gap when soft_l_adaptive_tau is enabled

soft_l_same_net_diag_split_sigma.description: distance-decay scale for per-net topology diagonal-split geometric scoring

soft_l_same_net_diag_split_min_support.description: minimum accumulated per-net topology diagonal-split support required before converting support into topo cost

soft_l_same_net_diag_split_max_distance.description: optional raw-distance cutoff for per-net topology diagonal-split scoring; use 0 to disable truncation and rely on soft decay only

l_shape_auto_disable_flag.description: whether auto-disable soft L-shape when telemetry indicates late-stage overshoot in diff-style runs

l_shape_auto_disable_warmup_updates.description: number of L-shape outer-loop updates to observe before considering auto-disable

l_shape_auto_disable_patience.description: number of consecutive qualifying outer-loop updates required before auto-disabling soft L-shape

l_shape_auto_disable_grad_overshoot_marg.description: minimum LGradRatio overshoot above LTargetRatio to count toward soft L-shape auto-disable

l_shape_auto_disable_lcost_rebound_ratio.description: fractional rebound above the best observed L-shape cost required to count toward auto-disable

l_shape_auto_disable_ov_ema_plateau_eps.description: maximum L-shape overflow EMA improvement treated as a plateau for auto-disable
